title: Teardown paths capture the Engram turn observation before the runtime is quiesced
outcome: Found by round-2 review of tm-winf step 1 (Codex /review-code, Medium). kill_session (src/session_lifecycle.rs, the engram_session_ids_to_terminate loop) and the revocation path shutdown_revoked_engram_mcp_runtimes (src/session_crud.rs) call checkpoint_engram_turn_off_lock with outcome Unknown, which captures the end basis and sends source_changed/source_basis, before shutdown_removed_runtime / shutdown_stopped_runtime stop the provider runtime. A mutating child can therefore write after the end capture or while the control call is pending; those writes are absent from the turn's only observation, which can even say source_changed=false and open no mutation-check obligation. Documented as a known limit in docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md. Fix direction: fence and stop the runtime while retaining the grant and the Engram control connection, then capture and checkpoint; a still-running runtime's snapshot is not its final execution source state. Care: the exit/termination callbacks of a stopped runtime also try to checkpoint; the per-grant report cache (round 2) makes the second closer repeat the first report, so ordering must keep exactly one closer building the report after the runtime is quiet.
